text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $80.5k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outpacing it at +1.7%, suggesting some rotation into altcoins despite Bitcoin's dominance remaining elevated at 60%. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 54 (neutral) and total volume at $41B reflects a cautious but balanced market where neither fear nor euphoria is driving price action. Altcoins like BNB and SOL are keeping pace with modest gains, indicating mild risk appetite without conviction.
